title: OpenText World 2026: What’s in it for the public sector industry?
summary: OpenText World 2026 has the public sector covered! Join us for sessions, breakouts, advisory boards, and forums tailored to your needs.
body_markdown:
Public sector organizations are faced with accelerating AI adoption, strengthening cybersecurity, modernizing citizen services, and managing growing volumes of information. But how can they achieve these goals while balancing innovation with trust, governance, and accountability?


[OpenText World 2026](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/summary-1?_gl=1*hsbl23*_gcl_au*NDUxOTgxMjYuMTc4NzY2NjE1Mg..*_ga*MTAzNTY3NTQ4Ni4xNzg3NjY2MTUy*_ga_8LWPJ50ZXY*czE3ODgyNzczNzkkbzYkZzEkdDE3ODgyOTAxMDIkajI3JGwwJGgxMTI4MDczNDgx) in Orlando, October 19–22, is the place to find answers to these challenges and more. The event’s public sector focus—including speaker sessions, breakouts, advisory boards, and forums—offers insight and advice about what’s on your mind today and what to think about for tomorrow.


Keith Nelson, OpenText Global Public Sector Senior Industry Strategist, talks about what’s in store at OpenText 2026.


New to this year’s conference is the **Industry Advisory Board** for public sector. This focused gathering brings together senior government and education leaders to discuss trends, challenges, and innovation opportunities. Participation is open to interested attendees and subject to approval to ensure a curated peer-to-peer experience. Find more information[here](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:b0383cbf-303c-4682-8546-a9e6973ac530) .


The conference also offers use cases, client success stories, how-to sessions, product roadmaps, round tables, and more. Here are just a few with a public sector lens that you won’t want to miss:


[Public sector industry client connect](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=44cf224c-5453-41a8-bb27-ce750602ed3e&shareLink=true)


Tuesday, 12:30 p.m.


Connect with others in the public sector industry to compare notes about best practices and lessons learned in an informal setting. Build your network of like-minded OpenText clients facing the same challenges as you and learn from each other’s mistakes and successes.


[Public sector industry forum](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=eab0cebf-47f3-4022-aafa-1638e95f42a7&shareLink=true)


Wednesday, 11:30 a.m.


Join customer speakers, public sector peers, and OpenText leaders for an interactive forum focused on the unique challenges and opportunities facing government agencies, higher education institutions, and public service organizations. Learn how peers are applying AI to enhance experiences, streamline operations, and make faster, more informed decisions.


[Make your content AI-ready and keep it that way with OpenText Knowledge Discovery](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=b99709cf-cd5a-4443-a585-74f05ccd42b5&shareLink=true)


Thursday, 9:45 a.m.


Learn how OpenText™ Knowledge Discovery helps organizations build and sustain a continuously AI-ready content foundation. We’ll show how intelligent enrichment, automated classification, and knowledge graph generation give agentic AI the structured context it needs to retrieve accurately, respond reliably, and act with confidence.


Check our[webpage](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=7b993b06-54a0-4275-946b-a5b2359da862&shareLink=true) often for newly added sessions.
